title: Joe and the Invisible Parade
synopsis: On a walk with Dad, Joe the puppy follows a whole parade of smells that his eyes cannot see.

related_resources.reason: Dogs have a particularly sensitive sense of smell and can notice scent traces humans might not perceive.
The imagined parade is an invitation to playful shared narration; it is not an assertion of a tested outcome.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: Joe could smell things Dad had not even noticed yet.
